title: An unclassified configuration field changes
context: Production casework, UK, assisted autonomy with human review

change.description: A field the change taxonomy does not classify appears in the Agent Passport.

labels.author: Decirance team (unreviewed)
labels.rationale: An unclassified difference could sever anything, so nothing may be assumed preserved: every claim is in question and a full reassessment is required. Evidence is not individually listed as invalidated because the engine cannot know which edges the unknown change touches — the honest answer is that none of it can be relied on until the change is classified. No ceiling can be computed for an unclassified change: the permit stops until the change is classified, and publishing any ceiling would overstate what is known.
